title: Multimodal Safety Evaluation of Vision-Language Models in Japanese
abstract: arXiv:2611.33789v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in Japanese-language settings, yet multimodal safety evaluation has been largely English-centric. We extend the Multimodal Safety Test Suite (MSTS) of R\"ottger et al. (2025) to Japanese as the 12th language, contributing 320 machine-translated and post-edited cases with reference answers plus 82 culturally localized Japanese images. We introduce an evaluation framework that (i) extends MSTS's 3-class safety grouping with a 5-point scale that also rewards useful (not just safe) responses, and (ii) separates image recognition from safety judgment to isolate recognition errors. translated_title: 视觉语言模型在日语环境下的多模态安全评估
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）日益被部署于日语应用场景中，然而多模态安全评估此前大多以英语为中心。我们将Röttger等人（2025）提出的多模态安全测试套件（MSTS）扩展至日语，使其成为该套件的第12种语言，贡献了320个经机器翻译并人工校对的测试案例（附参考答案），以及82张融入日本文化本地化特色的图像。我们提出了一个评估框架：（i）将MSTS原有的三类安全分组扩展为五分制评分，该评分不仅衡量回答是否安全，还会奖励回答的有用性；（ii）将图像识别与安全判断相分离，以便隔离识别错误。利用该框架，我们结合人工评估对五个现代日语视觉语言模型（Gemini-3-Flash、GPT-5、InternVL3、LLM-JP-4-VL、Qwen3-VL）进行了评测，发现各模型的安全就绪度存在显著差异。最后，我们评估了两个“以大语言模型作为评判者”（LLM-as-a-Judge）的模型，发现提供参考答案能够提升其评判效果。
tldr: 该论文将多模态安全测试套件MSTS扩展至日语（第12种语言）并构建了包含82张日本文化本地化图像的评估资源，同时提出区分图像识别与安全判断的五分制评估框架，据此对五个日语视觉语言模型进行安全评估，发现各模型安全就绪度差异显著，且提供参考答案可提升LLM评判者的评估效果。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the Multimodal Safety Test Suite (MSTS) to Japanese as its 12th language with 320 test cases and 82 culturally localized images, and introduces a 5-point evaluation framework that separates image recognition from safety judgment, revealing substantial variance in safety readiness among five modern Japanese VLMs, while showing that reference answers improve LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations.
